notes: The election results describe 9 May 2022 geography. The boundary file is compatible with that period: Maguindanao is undivided, Sulu is in BARMM, and the Negros Island Region is not yet represented.
Manila has one COMELEC city result but 14 district polygons; every district polygon maps to the same city result.
The boundary source still labels Davao de Oro as Compostela Valley; reviewed province compatibility is used for Compostela and Mabini.
Diacritics, city prefixes, and documented historical spellings are normalized only for matching; the source labels are preserved in the report.
